cite: SRD 5.2.1, Wizard Core Traits; Wizard Subclass; Ability Score Improvement
note: Core Traits table: "Armor Training: None"; "Weapon Proficiencies: Simple weapons"; "Skill Proficiencies: Choose 2: Arcana, History, Insight, Investigation, Medicine, Nature, or Religion". @4/feat matches the Ability Score Improvement feature's text (identical wording to Fighter's). R20: the SRD's Prepared Spells column (4/5/6/7/9 for levels 1-5) is not duplicated here as rows[].extra.preparedSpells — transformClasses() already carries the same values verbatim under the upstream row extra key extra['wizard-prepared-spells'] (ClassLevelRowSchema.extra keys are slug-only by design; a second camelCase copy would be redundant).

SRD text: "You know three Wizard cantrips of your choice ... When you reach Wizard levels 4 and 10, you learn another Wizard cantrip." cantripsKnown: '3 + floor(classLevel(wizard) / 4)' matches the vendored Cantrips column exactly through this task's level 1-5 scope (3 at levels 1-3, 4 at levels 4-5); at higher, out-of-scope levels it diverges from the table (e.g. predicts 5 at levels 8-9 where the table holds at 4) because the true progression is a stepped table, not a linear function of level — flagged for 1b. preparedCount is intentionally omitted — no formula: the 2024 Prepared Spells column is a table (4/5/6/7/9 for levels 1-5), not linear in level. That table already lives on the wizard class entity, at each level row's extra['wizard-prepared-spells'] (upstream-derived by transformClasses(), R12); 1b's derive should read the prepared-spells count from there rather than from this effect.

SRD text grants two free Evocation spells (level 2 or lower) added to the spellbook at level 3, plus one more whenever a new spell-slot level is reached. Recorded as a tag for 1a's text-level scope; the free-spellbook-addition mechanic is Phase-4/1b vocabulary.
SRD text: a damaging cantrip that misses its attack roll or is saved against still deals half damage (and no additional effect). Recorded as a tag for 1a's text-level scope.
